evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast, reliable receipt appeals to stability (no lost work) and mastery of the system's craft.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: The value appealed to is security and preservation — the system is designed so nothing is lost even under failure.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The design gives the caller self-origination over how and when to retrieve results — poll on own cadence or receive passively — appealing to autonomy and capability.
